mission: Evidence from every node spread across every flat surface. Sera pins Corridor maps to the bulkhead. Desh's tactical eye, Sera's historical vocabulary, Torin's Force-theoretical expertise, Kael's dry corrections — for the first time, the group synthesises rather than stalemates. The pattern resolves: each repurposed node is another antenna. Veraine is not attacking the seal; she is inverting its architecture.
why_now: Ben's leadership needs its first shared result. The intercept strategy is the frame; the amplification-array recognition is what makes the frame necessary.
conflict: Three traditions' worth of reading the same evidence could deadlock the room. The scene's work is that it does not. The synthesis is quiet, uneven, and productive — Desh connects nodes, Sera annotates the connections, Torin places them in Force theory, Kael pulls two of the conclusions apart with a single sentence and improves the rest.
turning_point: The Corridor map stops reading as a route and starts reading as a diagram. Veraine is not attacking the seal — she is inverting its architecture. The answer arrives as a group observation; no single speaker gets to own it.
opening_hook: Desh spreads every piece of evidence from every node across every flat surface on the ship. 'Let's see what she's actually doing.'
closing_hook: The amplification array. They can see the shape of it now — each repurposed node another antenna in a network aimed at Veranthos. Veraine isn't planning to attack the seal. She's planning to invert its own architecture.
emotional_trajectory: Analytical collaboration -> dawning understanding -> strategic alarm

stakes.personal: Ben runs the room and the room produces an answer none of them could reach alone
stakes.interpersonal: The group functioning as a team for the first time
stakes.external: Veraine's plan is more sophisticated and more dangerous than they assumed

setting: Aboard the Steady Returns — every surface covered with evidence and analysis
sensory_details: Tactical displays, archive data, environmental readings all overlaid; Desh's analyst-mode quiet; the Corridor map resolving into a weapon's diagram as the group's eyes move across it
action_beats: Desh spreads evidence from every node across every flat surface on the ship — datapads, manifests, sensor logs
Sera pins Corridor maps to the bulkhead and draws connections between node modifications in archaic notation
Ben traces the amplification array's shape on the tactical display as the pattern resolves
notes: First moment of genuine team function — not just cooperation but synthesis. Scene-level foreshadow of the climactic solution: disparate traditions producing an answer none could reach alone. Do not italicise the parallel. Diagnostic-voice trap — Ben should not, in this scene, articulate 'this is leadership through integration.' He runs the room and lets the room run itself; the synthesis is visible in the action and dialogue, not in his head. Voice: Zahn-procedural, short exchanges, one Allston-warm Desh line permitted near the close.
